b1-forradalom-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The March Youth
b1-forradalom-01.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview. The examiner asks what the March Youth demanded about the censorship on 15 March 1848.
b1-forradalom-01.prompt: Tell the examiner who made a demand about the censorship and what they demanded.
cues: Say what they demanded about the censorship
b1-forradalom-01.target: A márciusi ifjak azt követelték, hogy töröljék el a cenzúrát.
b1-forradalom-01.english: The March Youth demanded that the censorship be abolished.
b1-forradalom-01.canDo: I can say what happened in Pest on 15 March 1848.

b1-forradalom-02.title: Communicative Challenge: At the National Museum
b1-forradalom-02.scenario: You are visiting the National Museum in Budapest. The guide asks what the crowd wanted outside the building on 15 March 1848.
b1-forradalom-02.prompt: Tell the guide what the people wanted about a ministry and about the political prisoners.
cues: Say what they wanted about a ministry
Say what they wanted about the prisoners
b1-forradalom-02.target: Az emberek azt kívánták, hogy legyen felelős minisztérium Buda-Pesten. Azt is kívánták, hogy szabadítsák ki a politikai foglyokat.
b1-forradalom-02.english: The people demanded that there be a responsible ministry in Buda-Pest. They also demanded that the political prisoners be freed.
b1-forradalom-02.canDo: I can say what the Twelve Points demanded.

b1-forradalom-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Debrecen, April 1849
b1-forradalom-03.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks what happened in the Great Church of Debrecen in April 1849.
b1-forradalom-03.prompt: Tell the examiner who read out the Declaration of Independence and what the assembly declared.
cues: Say who read out the Declaration
Say what the assembly declared about the Habsburg dynasty
b1-forradalom-03.target: Kossuth Lajos felolvasta a Függetlenségi Nyilatkozatot. A gyűlés kimondta a Habsburg-ház trónfosztását.
b1-forradalom-03.english: Lajos Kossuth read out the Declaration of Independence. The assembly declared the dethronement of the House of Habsburg.
b1-forradalom-03.canDo: I can say what the Declaration of Independence declared in 1849.

b1-forradalom-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Spring Campaign
b1-forradalom-04.scenario: You are a history teacher preparing a short talk. A colleague asks which battle and which castle you will mention from the Spring Campaign of 1849.
b1-forradalom-04.prompt: Tell your colleague about the battle where the Honvéds defeated the imperial army and about the castle they recaptured.
cues: Say which battle and what the Honvéds did there
Say which castle they recaptured and when
b1-forradalom-04.target: Április 6-án az isaszegi csatában a honvédek legyőzték a császári sereget. Május 21-én visszafoglalták Buda várát.
b1-forradalom-04.english: On 6 April the Honvéds defeated the imperial army at the Battle of Isaszeg. On 21 May they recaptured Buda castle.
b1-forradalom-04.canDo: I can name the main events of the Spring Campaign of 1849.

b1-forradalom-05.title: Communicative Challenge: 6 October 1849
b1-forradalom-05.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview. The examiner asks what happened on 6 October 1849.
b1-forradalom-05.prompt: Tell the examiner who was executed in Pest and who was executed in Arad on that day.
cues: Say who was executed in Pest
Say who was executed in Arad
b1-forradalom-05.target: 1849. október 6-án Pesten kivégezték Batthyány Lajost, Aradon pedig a tizenhárom vértanút.
b1-forradalom-05.english: On 6 October 1849 Lajos Batthyány was executed in Pest, and the thirteen martyrs in Arad.
b1-forradalom-05.canDo: I can say what happened at Világos and at Arad in 1849.

b1-forradalom-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: 1848-49 in Three Sentences
b1-forradalom-consolidation.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks you to sum up the revolution and war of independence in three short sentences.
b1-forradalom-consolidation.prompt: Tell the examiner what the March Youth demanded, what the assembly declared in 1849 and what happened at Világos.
cues: Say what the March Youth demanded
Say what the assembly declared in April 1849
b1-forradalom-consolidation.target: 1848. március 15-én a márciusi ifjak követelték a sajtószabadságot. 1849 áprilisában kimondták a Habsburg-ház trónfosztását. Augusztus 13-án volt a világosi fegyverletétel.
b1-forradalom-consolidation.english: On 15 March 1848 the March Youth demanded freedom of the press. In April 1849 the dethronement of the House of Habsburg was declared. On 13 August came the surrender at Világos.
b1-forradalom-consolidation.canDo: I can sum up the events of 1848-49 in three sentences.
